description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Biovisionary and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat one additional time.
Cast Mind Games by paying {U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Vesuvian Duplimancy triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
